description: Inspect vote totals, turnout, party/list vote shares, bloc winner and lead for one FV or KV election. Year is required. With no geography it returns national data; region, constituency, nomination district, municipality, and polling area arguments drill into applicable scopes. Optional party filtering accepts names, abbreviations, list letters, and list IDs. National FV seats are calculated by Politikdata and explicitly not officially verified mandate counts.

constituency.description: Folketingsvalg constituency (Danish: storkreds) code or name.

election_type.description: FV for Folketingsvalg or KV for Kommunalvalg.

municipality.description: Municipality code, slug, or name, for example Horsens.

nomination_district.description: Folketingsvalg nomination district (Danish: opstillingskreds) code or name.

party.description: Optional party name, abbreviation, list letter, or election list ID.

polling_area.description: Polling area (Danish: afstemningsområde) DAGI code or name.

region.description: Region code or name, for example Region Midtjylland.

year.description: Election year. Returns election_not_found when no matching election exists.

name: get_election_votes
